what: openworld/catch-bowl (one arid-and-mountain region of six whole biome polygons: the catch, the bowl, SE outer wall, stalker range, Stalker Gate and twins; 751,000 km2 filled in a 1,280 x 1,052 km box at 1 km cells) ceilings.

catch-bowl.html.why: The owner lifted the 16 MB page cap for this region on 2026-11-24: "We can lift the 16 MB restriction btw... this place will be godot native and go into a godot ported version of the host." The page is the Godot build's source rather than a gallery file, so the gallery's 16 MB limit does not bind it; the ceilings that do bind are tris, calls, samplers and vram_mb, which are the Godot build's costs too and are left at their defaults until the first cut measures them.
